UIWindowScene) else { return } // Check the connection options to see if the scene is being created // in response to an NFC event. guard let nfcEvent = connectionOptions.nfcEvent else { return } // If there's an event, update the view model. myViewModel.receivedNFCEvent = nfcEvent // Update the view hierarchy by using myViewModel to create a new // view. } func windowScene(_ windowScene: UIWindowScene, didReceiveNFCWindowSceneEvent event: NFCWindowSceneEvent) { // Update the view model with the NFC event. myViewModel.receivedNFCEvent = event // Update the view hierarchy by using myViewModel to create a new // view. } } ```
